interpreters.description: Named Python executables on SSH targets.

path.description: Path or executable name on the server.

target.description: Name of an SSH connection in targets.

condaExecutable.description: Absolute path to the Conda executable for environments whose Conda installation cannot be discovered.

defaultInterpreter.description: Interpreter used by scripts without an override.

uploadOnSave.description: Automatically upload eligible files after editor saves or changes written directly to the local workspace.

deleteRemoteOnUpload.description: Delete remote files when local files are deleted during upload.

proxy.description: Proxy URL injected into the launched Python process as HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and ALL_PROXY.

scripts.description: Script options keyed by workspace-relative Python paths with forward slashes.

runConfigurations.description: Named presets for running and debugging a Python script or module.

activeRunConfiguration.description: Selected preset for toolbar Run and Debug. Omit to use the current Python file.

syncMode.description: Incremental deploys once then uploads changed files. Full compares with the server each launch. Off skips launch sync.

syncPolicy.description: Conflict policy. Safe stops on remote changes. Force upload replaces the remote version. Force download replaces the local version. Interactive asks per conflict.

uploadPolicy.description: Conflict policy for automatic and launch uploads.

module.description: Dotted Python module name, run as python -m.

program.description: Workspace-relative path of the Python script.

localPython.description: Local Python executable name or path. Omit to detect the interpreter automatically.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory mapped to the server.

proxy.description: Proxy URL injected into the launched Python process as HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and ALL_PROXY.

syncMode.description: Override project synchronization for this script or named configuration.

syncPolicy.description: Override the project conflict policy for this script or named configuration.

uploadPolicy.description: Override the project upload policy for this script or named configuration.

runOn.description: Choose local Python or a RunHop SSH target. Omit to use a named remote interpreter or a mapped target when available.

host.description: Server hostname or OpenSSH config alias.

passphrase.description: Set true to prompt for an encrypted key.

authentication.description: How RunHop authenticates the SSH connection. Passwords are entered through VS Code.

ignore.description: Gitignore-style patterns excluded from startup sync and upload on save, relative to the connection context. Example: /datasets/.

ignoreFile.description: Path to an ignore file with rules shared by startup sync and upload on save.

name.description: Use this name as the interpreter's optional target.

context.description: The local project directory within the workspace.
